evidence.quote: You can call or message only verified recipients from a trial account. Twilio removes this security restriction when you upgrade your account.

sandbox_or_test_env.why: Free trial account with restricted verified-recipient testing and same credentials as production acts as test environment.

evidence.quote: You can sign up for a Twilio free trial account without a credit card.

buildability.main_blocker.why: Self-serve trial gives credentials; paid account only needed for A2P 10DLC production, not a blocker to build.

rationale: Self-serve free trial with immediate credentials; A2P 10DLC needs paid account but does not block building.
